    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)

library(Seurat)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(ggplot2)

# Load data from current directory
sc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
sc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sc.data, project = "pbmc3k", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Add mitochondrial percentage
sc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sc, pattern = "^MT-")

# QC filtering
sc <- subset(sc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalization
sc <- NormalizeData(sc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
sc <- FindVariableFeatures(sc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
sc <- ScaleData(sc, features = VariableFeatures(sc))

# Run PCA
sc <- RunPCA(sc, features = VariableFeatures(sc))

# Run UMAP
sc <- RunUMAP(sc, dims = 1:10)

# Find neighbors and clusters
sc <- FindNeighbors(sc, dims = 1:10)
sc <- FindClusters(sc, resolution = 0.5)

# DoubletFinder: pK identification
sweep.res.list <- paramSweep_v3(sc, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Select optimal pK
pK_value <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Calculate expected doublets
annotations <- sc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi <- round(0.075 * nrow(sc@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

# Run DoubletFinder
sc <- doubletFinder_v3(sc, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = pK_value, nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

DimPlot(sc, reduction = "umap", group.by = classification_col, pt.size = 0.5) +

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

# Load 10X data from current directory
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object with basic filtering
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale all genes (important for DE analysis)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Differential expression analysis between cluster 0 and cluster 3
cluster0vs3.markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = 0, ident.2 = 3, min.pct = 0.25)

# Prepare data for volcano plot
cluster0vs3.markers$gene <- rownames(cluster0vs3.markers)
cluster0vs3.markers$diffexpressed <- "NO"
cluster0vs3.markers$diffexpressed[cluster0vs3.markers$avg_log2FC > 1 & cluster0vs3.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05] <- "UP"
cluster0vs3.markers$diffexpressed[cluster0vs3.markers$avg_log2FC < -1 & cluster0vs3.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05] <- "DOWN"

# Create volcano plot
volcano_plot <- ggplot(data = cluster0vs3.markers, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), col = diffexpressed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), col = "gray", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "gray", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("DOWN" = "#00AFBB", "NO" = "grey", "UP" = "#bb0c00"),
                     labels = c("Downregulated", "Not significant", "Upregulated")) +
  labs(color = "Differential Expression",
       x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       title = "Differential Gene Expression: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12))

print(volcano_plot)

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Find neighbors
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), col = "gray", linetype = 'dashed') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "gray", linetype = 'dashed') +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("DOWN" = "#00AFBB", "NO" = "grey", "UP" = "#bb0c00"),
                     labels = c("Downregulated", "Not significant", "Upregulated")) +
  labs(color = "Differential Expression",
       x = "log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-log10(Adjusted P-value)",
       title = "Volcano Plot: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3") +

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================================
# 1. DATA LOADING
# ============================================================================
# Load 10X data from current working directory
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object with initial filtering
# min.cells = 3: keep features detected in at least 3 cells
# min.features = 200: keep cells with at least 200 detected features
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, 
                           project = "PBMC_Analysis", 
                           min.cells = 3, 
                           min.features = 200)

# ============================================================================
# 2. QUALITY CONTROL
# ============================================================================
# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

# Feature scatter plots for QC
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 15)

# ============================================================================
# 3. NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================================
# Normalize data using LogNormalize method
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# ============================================================================
# 4. FEATURE SELECTION
# ============================================================================
# Identify highly variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
print(paste("Top 10 variable features:", paste(top10, collapse = ", ")))

# Plot variable features
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
plot2

# ============================================================================
# 5. SCALING
# ============================================================================
# Scale data (required before PCA)
all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# ============================================================================
# 6. DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION - PCA
# ============================================================================
# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Visualize PCA results
print(pbmc[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
VizDimLoadings(pbmc, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")

# Determine dimensionality using Elbow plot
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

# Heatmap of PCs
DimHeatmap(pbmc, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)

# ============================================================================
# 7. CLUSTERING
# ============================================================================
# Construct KNN graph and find clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Check cluster assignments
head(Idents(pbmc), 5)

# ============================================================================
# 8. NON-LINEAR DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION - UMAP
# ============================================================================
# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Visualize UMAP
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5)

# ============================================================================
# 9. FIND CLUSTER BIOMARKERS
# ============================================================================
# Find markers for all clusters
pbmc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Display top markers per cluster
pbmc.markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)

# Find markers for cluster 0
cluster0.markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = 0, min.pct = 0.25)
head(cluster0.markers, n = 5)

# ============================================================================
# 10. VISUALIZATION OF MARKER GENES
# ============================================================================
# Violin plot for specific markers
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("MS4A1", "CD79A"))

# Feature plot on UMAP
FeaturePlot(pbmc, features = c("MS4A1", "GNLY", "CD3E", "CD14", "FCER1A", "FCGR3A", "LYZ", "PPBP", "CD8A"))

# Heatmap of top markers
top10_markers <- pbmc.markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

DoHeatmap(pbmc, features = top10_markers$gene) + NoLegend()

# 11. CELL TYPE ANNOTATION (Example)
# ============================================================================
# Assign cell type identities based on canonical markers

DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + NoLegend()

saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_analysis_final.rds")

library(Seurat)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(ggplot2)

# Load 10X data
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Standard Seurat preprocessing
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:30)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:30)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# pK optimization
sweep.res <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:30, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Plot pK optimization
ggplot(bcmvn, aes(pK, BCmetric, group = 1)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "pK Optimization")

# Select optimal pK
optimal_pK <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Calculate expected doublets
annotations <- pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi <- round(0.008 * ncol(pbmc))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

# Run DoubletFinder
pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:30, pN = 0.25, pK = optimal_pK, 
                         nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Get classification column name

  ggtitle("Doublet Detection Results")

# Filter singlets

# Visualize singlets only
DimPlot(pbmc_singlets, reduction = "umap", group.by = "seurat_clusters") +
  ggtitle("Singlets Only")

# Summary statistics

cat("Singlets:", ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")
cat("Doublets removed:", ncol(pbmc) - ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")

# Load data
sc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")
sc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = sc.data, project = "pbmc3k", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# QC metrics
sc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(sc, pattern = "^MT-")

# QC filtering
sc <- subset(sc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalization
sc <- NormalizeData(sc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
sc <- FindVariableFeatures(sc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
sc <- ScaleData(sc, features = rownames(sc))

# PCA
sc <- RunPCA(sc, features = VariableFeatures(object = sc))

# Clustering
sc <- FindNeighbors(sc, dims = 1:10)
sc <- FindClusters(sc, resolution = 0.5)

# UMAP
sc <- RunUMAP(sc, dims = 1:10)

# DoubletFinder parameter sweep
sweep.res.list <- paramSweep_v3(sc, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Extract optimal pK
pK_value <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Estimate doublet proportion
annotations <- sc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)
nExp_poi <- round(0.075 * nrow(sc@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

# Run DoubletFinder
sc <- doubletFinder_v3(sc, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = pK_value, nExp = nExp_poi.adj, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Find DoubletFinder classification column
df_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(sc@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# Visualize doublets
DimPlot(sc, reduction = "umap", group.by = df_col)

# Create Seurat object with quality filters
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Differential expression analysis between cluster 0 and cluster 3
cluster0vs3.markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = 0, ident.2 = 3, test.use = "wilcox")

# Add gene names as column
cluster0vs3.markers$gene <- rownames(cluster0vs3.markers)

# Handle p_val_adj = 0 cases (set to minimum non-zero value)
min_pval <- min(cluster0vs3.markers$p_val_adj[cluster0vs3.markers$p_val_adj > 0])
cluster0vs3.markers$p_val_adj[cluster0vs3.markers$p_val_adj == 0] <- min_pval

# Add significance column
cluster0vs3.markers$significance <- "Not Significant"
cluster0vs3.markers$significance[cluster0vs3.markers$avg_log2FC > 1 & cluster0vs3.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05] <- "Upregulated in Cluster 0"
cluster0vs3.markers$significance[cluster0vs3.markers$avg_log2FC < -1 & cluster0vs3.markers$p_val_adj < 0.05] <- "Downregulated in Cluster 0"

# Create volcano plot
volcano_plot <- ggplot(cluster0vs3.markers, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Downregulated in Cluster 0" = "#00AFBB", 
                                 "Not Significant" = "grey", 
                                 "Upregulated in Cluster 0" = "#bb0c00")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Differential Expression: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3",
       x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       color = "Significance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(volcano_plot)

# Print summary statistics
cat("\nDifferentially Expressed Genes Summary:\n")
cat("Upregulated in Cluster 0:", sum(cluster0vs3.markers$significance == "Upregulated in Cluster 0"), "\n")
cat("Downregulated in Cluster 0:", sum(cluster0vs3.markers$significance == "Downregulated in Cluster 0"), "\n")
cat("Not Significant:", sum(cluster0vs3.markers$significance == "Not Significant"), "\n")

# 2. Create Seurat object
# Keep genes expressed in at least 3 cells, and cells with at least 200 genes
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, 
                           project = "PBMC", 
                           min.cells = 3, 
                           min.features = 200)

# 3. Quality control metrics
# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

# Feature scatter plots for QC
plot1 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt")
plot2 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA")
plot1 + plot2

# 4. Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# 5. Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# 6. Identify highly variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
plot2

# 7. Scale data
all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# 8. Perform linear dimensional reduction (PCA)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

print(pbmc[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
VizDimLoadings(pbmc, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")
DimHeatmap(pbmc, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)

# 9. Determine dimensionality
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

# 10. Cluster cells
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# 11. Run UMAP for visualization
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Visualize UMAP
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE)

# 12. Find cluster biomarkers
pbmc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, 
                               only.pos = TRUE, 
                               min.pct = 0.25, 
                               logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Display top markers per cluster
pbmc.markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)

# Visualize top marker genes
top_markers <- pbmc.markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)

DoHeatmap(pbmc, features = top_markers$gene) + NoLegend()

# Feature plots for specific markers
FeaturePlot(pbmc, features = c("MS4A1", "GNLY", "CD3E", "CD14", 
                               "FCER1A", "FCGR3A", "LYZ", "PPBP", "CD8A"))

# Violin plots for marker expression
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("MS4A1", "CD79A"))

# 13. Save the Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_analysis.rds")

# Print summary
print(paste("Total cells analyzed:", ncol(pbmc)))
print(paste("Number of clusters identified:", length(unique(Idents(pbmc)))))

library(Seurat)
library(DoubletFinder)
library(ggplot2)

# Load 10X data
pbmc_data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc_data, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Preprocessing
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))

# pK optimization
sweep.res <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:20, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Plot pK optimization
ggplot(bcmvn, aes(pK, BCmetric, group = 1)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_minimal()

# Select optimal pK
pK_value <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Calculate expected doublets
nExp_poi <- round(0.08 * nrow(pbmc@meta.data))

# Run DoubletFinder
pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:20, pN = 0.25, pK = pK_value, nExp = nExp_poi, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

# Get classification column name
classification_col <- grep("^DF.classifications", colnames(pbmc@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# Visualize doublets
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca", group.by = classification_col)

# Remove doublets
pbmc_singlets <- subset(pbmc, subset = get(classification_col) == "Singlet")

# Summary
cat("Original cells:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Singlets:", ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")
cat("Doublets removed:", ncol(pbmc) - ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")

library(Seurat)
library(DoubletFinder)

# Load 10x data from current directory
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, npcs = 30)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Optimize pK parameter
sweep.res <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:20, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Select optimal pK
pK_optimal <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc3k", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Read the 10X data
pbmc_data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc_data, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc))

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Set identity class to clusters
Idents(pbmc) <- pbmc$seurat_clusters

# Perform differential expression analysis between cluster 0 and cluster 1
cluster_markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = 0, ident.2 = 1, test.use = "wilcox", logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.1)

# Add gene names as a column
cluster_markers$gene <- rownames(cluster_markers)

# Filter significant genes
sig_markers <- cluster_markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj)

# Display top 20 significant genes
print(head(sig_markers, 20))

# Create volcano plot
cluster_markers$diffexpressed <- "NO"
cluster_markers$diffexpressed[cluster_markers$avg_log2FC > 0.5 & cluster_markers$p_val_adj < 0.05] <- "UP"
cluster_markers$diffexpressed[cluster_markers$avg_log2FC < -0.5 & cluster_markers$p_val_adj < 0.05] <- "DOWN"

volcano_plot <- ggplot(cluster_markers, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), col = diffexpressed)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "grey", "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), col = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), col = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Differential Expression: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 1",
       x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value") +
  theme_minimal()

print(volcano_plot)

# Get top 10 upregulated and downregulated genes
top_up <- sig_markers %>% filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
top_down <- sig_markers %>% filter(avg_log2FC < 0) %>% slice_head(n = 10)
top_genes <- c(top_up$gene, top_down$gene)

# Feature plot for top genes (first 9 to avoid overcrowding)
if(length(top_genes) > 0) {
  feature_genes <- head(top_genes, 9)
  feature_plot <- FeaturePlot(pbmc, features = feature_genes, ncol = 3)
  print(feature_plot)
}

# Violin plot for top genes
if(length(top_genes) > 0) {
  violin_genes <- head(top_genes, 6)
  violin_plot <- VlnPlot(pbmc, features = violin_genes, ncol = 3, idents = c(0, 1))
  print(violin_plot)
}

# Heatmap of top differentially expressed genes
if(nrow(sig_markers) > 0) {
  top_markers <- head(sig_markers, 20)
  heatmap_plot <- DoHeatmap(subset(pbmc, idents = c(0, 1)), features = top_markers$gene, size = 3)
  print(heatmap_plot)
}

# Save results
write.csv(cluster_markers, "cluster0_vs_cluster1_DEGs.csv", row.names = FALSE)

pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

library(Seurat)

# ============================================================================
# 1. DATA LOADING
# ============================================================================

# Read the Matrix Market format file
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Read barcodes and genes
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Set row and column names
rownames(matrix) <- genes$V2  # Use HGNC gene symbols
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$V1  # Use cell barcodes

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, 
                           project = "PBMC2700", 
                           min.cells = 3,      # Keep genes expressed in >= 3 cells
                           min.features = 200) # Keep cells with >= 200 genes

# ============================================================================
# 2. QUALITY CONTROL
# ============================================================================

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & 
                              nFeature_RNA < 2500 & 
                              percent.mt < 5)

# ============================================================================
# 3. NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, 
                      normalization.method = "LogNormalize", 
                      scale.factor = 10000)

# ============================================================================
# 4. FEATURE SELECTION
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, 
                             selection.method = "vst", 
                             nfeatures = 2000)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
print(paste("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", ")))

# Plot variable features
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
print(plot2)

# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================

pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# ============================================================================
# 6. DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION (PCA)
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Examine and visualize PCA results
print(pbmc[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
VizDimLoadings(pbmc, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")

# Determine dimensionality of the dataset
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

# ============================================================================
# 7. CLUSTERING
# ============================================================================

# Find neighbors
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Find clusters
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Check number of cells per cluster
table(Idents(pbmc))

# ============================================================================
# 8. NON-LINEAR DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION (UMAP)
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

  ggtitle("UMAP of PBMC 2,700 cells")

                               only.pos = TRUE,           # Only positive markers
                               min.pct = 0.25,            # Min % of cells expressing
                               logfc.threshold = 0.25)    # Log2FC threshold

print(head(pbmc.markers, n = 20))

top10_markers <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +

    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),

# ============================================================================
# PBMC Single-Cell RNA-seq Analysis Pipeline
# ============================================================================
# This script performs a complete analysis of 2,700 PBMCs including:
# - Data loading from Matrix Market format
# - Quality control and filtering
# - Normalization and scaling
# - Dimensionality reduction (PCA)
# - Clustering
# - UMAP visualization
# - Saving final Seurat object
# ============================================================================

# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)

# ============================================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================================

cat("Loading data from Matrix Market format...\n")

# Read the sparse matrix (genes x cells)
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Read barcodes (cell identifiers)
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(barcodes) <- "barcode"

# Read genes (gene identifiers and symbols)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(genes) <- c("gene_id", "gene_symbol")

# Assign row and column names to the matrix
rownames(matrix) <- genes$gene_symbol
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$barcode

cat(sprintf("Loaded matrix: %d genes x %d cells\n", nrow(matrix), ncol(matrix)))

# ============================================================================
# 2. CREATE SEURAT OBJECT
# ============================================================================

cat("\nCreating Seurat object...\n")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = matrix,
  project = "PBMC2700",
  min.cells = 3,      # Keep genes expressed in at least 3 cells
  min.features = 200  # Keep cells with at least 200 genes
)

cat(sprintf("Seurat object created: %d genes x %d cells\n", 
            nrow(pbmc), ncol(pbmc)))

# ============================================================================
# 3. QUALITY CONTROL
# ============================================================================

cat("\nPerforming quality control...\n")

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics before filtering
cat("\nQC Metrics Summary (before filtering):\n")
print(summary(pbmc$nFeature_RNA))
print(summary(pbmc$nCount_RNA))
print(summary(pbmc$percent.mt))

# Create QC plots
p1 <- VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), 
              ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1)
ggsave("qc_violin_before_filtering.pdf", p1, width = 12, height = 4)

p2 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2500, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 200, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")
ggsave("qc_scatter_before_filtering.pdf", p2, width = 6, height = 5)

# ============================================================================
# 4. FILTER LOW-QUALITY CELLS
# ============================================================================

cat("\nFiltering low-quality cells...\n")

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = 
                 nFeature_RNA > 200 &      # Minimum genes per cell
                 nFeature_RNA < 2500 &     # Maximum genes per cell (doublet filter)
                 percent.mt < 5)           # Maximum mitochondrial percentage

cat(sprintf("After filtering: %d genes x %d cells\n", 
            nrow(pbmc), ncol(pbmc)))

# QC plots after filtering
p3 <- VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), 
              ncol = 3, pt.size = 0.1)
ggsave("qc_violin_after_filtering.pdf", p3, width = 12, height = 4)

# ============================================================================
# 5. NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================================

cat("\nNormalizing data...\n")

# Log-normalize the data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, 
                      normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                      scale.factor = 10000)

# ============================================================================
# 6. IDENTIFY HIGHLY VARIABLE FEATURES
# ============================================================================

cat("\nIdentifying highly variable features...\n")

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, 
                             selection.method = "vst",
                             nfeatures = 2000)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable genes:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Plot variable features
p4 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
p4 <- LabelPoints(plot = p4, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
ggsave("variable_features.pdf", p4, width = 8, height = 6)

# ============================================================================
# 7. SCALING
# ============================================================================

cat("\nScaling data...\n")

# Scale the data (regress out mitochondrial percentage)
all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, 
                  features = all.genes,
                  vars.to.regress = "percent.mt")

# ============================================================================
# 8. DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION - PCA
# ============================================================================

cat("\nPerforming PCA...\n")

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, 
               features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc),
               npcs = 50,
               verbose = FALSE)

# Visualize PCA results
p5 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")
ggsave("pca_plot.pdf", p5, width = 7, height = 6)

# Elbow plot to determine dimensionality
p6 <- ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)
ggsave("elbow_plot.pdf", p6, width = 7, height = 5)

# Determine number of PCs to use (where elbow occurs, typically 10-30)
n_pcs <- 20
cat(sprintf("Using %d principal components for downstream analysis\n", n_pcs))

# ============================================================================
# 9. CLUSTERING
# ============================================================================

cat("\nPerforming clustering...\n")

# Find neighbors
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:n_pcs)

# Find clusters (resolution parameter determines granularity)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("Identified %d clusters\n", 
            length(unique(Idents(pbmc)))))

# Print cluster sizes
cat("\nCluster sizes:\n")
print(table(Idents(pbmc)))

# ============================================================================
# 10. UMAP VISUALIZATION
# ============================================================================

cat("\nComputing UMAP...\n")

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:n_pcs, verbose = FALSE)

# Visualize UMAP
p7 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 5) +
  ggtitle("PBMC Clusters (UMAP)")
ggsave("umap_clusters.pdf", p7, width = 8, height = 7)

# UMAP colored by QC metrics
p8 <- FeaturePlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
                  reduction = "umap", ncol = 3)
ggsave("umap_qc_metrics.pdf", p8, width = 15, height = 5)

# ============================================================================
# 11. FIND CLUSTER MARKERS (Optional but recommended)
# ============================================================================

cat("\nFinding cluster markers...\n")

# Find markers for all clusters
pbmc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, 
                               only.pos = TRUE,
                               min.pct = 0.25,
                               logfc.threshold = 0.25,
                               verbose = FALSE)

# Get top 5 markers per cluster
top5_markers <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC)

cat("\nTop 5 markers per cluster:\n")
print(top5_markers)

# Save marker genes to file
write.csv(pbmc.markers, "cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(top5_markers, "top5_markers_per_cluster.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Visualize top markers
if (nrow(top5_markers) > 0) {
  p9 <- DoHeatmap(pbmc, features = top5_markers$gene) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
  ggsave("marker_heatmap.pdf", p9, width = 12, height = 10)
}

# ============================================================================
# 12. SAVE FINAL SEURAT OBJECT
# ============================================================================

cat("\nSaving final Seurat object...\n")

# Save the complete Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_final.rds")

cat("\n============================================================================\n")
cat("Analysis complete!\n")
cat("============================================================================\n")
cat(sprintf("Final object: %d genes x %d cells\n", nrow(pbmc), ncol(pbmc)))
cat(sprintf("Number of clusters: %d\n", length(unique(Idents(pbmc)))))
cat(sprintf("Saved to: pbmc_final.rds\n"))
cat("\nGenerated files:\n")
cat("  - pbmc_final.rds (Seurat object)\n")
cat("  - cluster_markers.csv (all marker genes)\n")
cat("  - top5_markers_per_cluster.csv (top markers)\n")
cat("  - qc_violin_before_filtering.pdf\n")
cat("  - qc_violin_after_filtering.pdf\n")
cat("  - qc_scatter_before_filtering.pdf\n")
cat("  - variable_features.pdf\n")
cat("  - pca_plot.pdf\n")
cat("  - elbow_plot.pdf\n")
cat("  - umap_clusters.pdf\n")
cat("  - umap_qc_metrics.pdf\n")

# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(DoubletFinder)

library(dplyr)

# ============================================
# 1. Load 10x Genomics Data
# ============================================
# Assuming your files are in a directory called "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "path/to/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, 
                           project = "PBMC", 
                           min.cells = 3, 
                           min.features = 200)

# ============================================
# 2. Quality Control and Filtering
# ============================================
# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & 
                              nFeature_RNA < 6000 & 
                              percent.mt < 15)

# ============================================
# 3. Standard Pre-processing
# ============================================
# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Determine dimensionality
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

# ============================================
# 4. Clustering for DoubletFinder
# ============================================
# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:30)

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:30)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# ============================================
# 5. DoubletFinder - Parameter Optimization
# ============================================
# pK Identification (no ground-truth)
sweep.res.list <- paramSweep_v3(pbmc, PCs = 1:30, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Select optimal pK
pK_optimal <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))
cat("Optimal pK:", pK_optimal, "\n")

# ============================================
# 6. Estimate Doublet Rate
# ============================================
# Homotypic doublet proportion estimate
annotations <- pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homotypic.prop <- modelHomotypic(annotations)

# Expected doublet rate (adjust based on cell recovery)
# Rule of thumb: ~0.8% per 1000 cells recovered
nCells <- ncol(pbmc)
expected_doublet_rate <- nCells / 1000 * 0.008

# Adjust for homotypic doublets
nExp_poi <- round(expected_doublet_rate * nCells)
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

cat("Expected doublets:", nExp_poi, "\n")
cat("Adjusted for homotypic doublets:", nExp_poi.adj, "\n")

# ============================================
# 7. Run DoubletFinder
# ============================================
pbmc <- doubletFinder_v3(pbmc, 
                         PCs = 1:30, 
                         pN = 0.25, 
                         pK = pK_optimal, 
                         nExp = nExp_poi.adj, 
                         reuse.pANN = FALSE, 
                         sct = FALSE)

# Get the doublet classification column name (it's auto-generated)
doublet_col <- colnames(pbmc@meta.data)[grep("DF.classifications", colnames(pbmc@meta.data))]

# ============================================
# 8. Visualize Doublets
# ============================================
# UMAP with doublet labels
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = doublet_col, 
        cols = c("red", "gray")) +
  ggtitle("Doublet Detection Results")

# Doublet distribution across clusters
table(pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters, pbmc@meta.data[[doublet_col]])

# ============================================
# 9. Remove Doublets
# ============================================
# Count doublets
n_doublets <- sum(pbmc@meta.data[[doublet_col]] == "Doublet")
cat("Number of doublets detected:", n_doublets, "\n")
cat("Percentage of doublets:", round(n_doublets/ncol(pbmc)*100, 2), "%\n")

# Remove doublets
pbmc_singlets <- subset(pbmc, subset = pbmc@meta.data[[doublet_col]] == "Singlet")

cat("Cells before doublet removal:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Cells after doublet removal:", ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")

# ============================================
# 10. Re-process Cleaned Data
# ============================================
# Re-run standard workflow on singlets
pbmc_singlets <- NormalizeData(pbmc_singlets)

pbmc_singlets <- ScaleData(pbmc_singlets)
pbmc_singlets <- RunPCA(pbmc_singlets)
pbmc_singlets <- RunUMAP(pbmc_singlets, dims = 1:30)
pbmc_singlets <- FindNeighbors(pbmc_singlets, dims = 1:30)
pbmc_singlets <- FindClusters(pbmc_singlets, resolution = 0.5)

# Visualize cleaned data
DimPlot(pbmc_singlets, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("PBMC Data After Doublet Removal")

# ============================================
# 11. Save Results
# ============================================
# Save cleaned Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc_singlets, file = "pbmc_singlets_cleaned.rds")

# Export doublet information
write.csv(pbmc@meta.data, file = "doublet_detection_results.csv")

# Save plots
ggsave("doublet_umap.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)

# Adjust for homotypic doublets
nExp_poi <- round(expected_doublet_rate * nCells)
nExp_poi.adj <- round(nExp_poi * (1 - homotypic.prop))

cat("Expected doublets:", nExp_poi, "\n")
cat("Adjusted for homotypic doublets:", nExp_poi.adj, "\n")

# ============================================
# 7. Run DoubletFinder
# ============================================

                         PCs = 1:30, 
                         pN = 0.25, 
                         pK = pK_optimal, 
                         nExp = nExp_poi.adj, 
                         reuse.pANN = FALSE, 
                         sct = FALSE)

# Get the doublet classification column name (it's auto-generated)
doublet_col <- colnames(pbmc@meta.data)[grep("DF.classifications", colnames(pbmc@meta.data))]

# ============================================
# 8. Visualize Doublets
# ============================================
# UMAP with doublet labels
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = doublet_col, 
        cols = c("red", "gray")) +
  ggtitle("Doublet Detection Results")

# Doublet distribution across clusters
table(pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters, pbmc@meta.data[[doublet_col]])

# ============================================
# 9. Remove Doublets
# ============================================
# Count doublets
n_doublets <- sum(pbmc@meta.data[[doublet_col]] == "Doublet")
cat("Number of doublets detected:", n_doublets, "\n")
cat("Percentage of doublets:", round(n_doublets/ncol(pbmc)*100, 2), "%\n")

# Remove doublets
pbmc_singlets <- subset(pbmc, subset = pbmc@meta.data[[doublet_col]] == "Singlet")

cat("Cells before doublet removal:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Cells after doublet removal:", ncol(pbmc_singlets), "\n")

# ============================================

pbmc_singlets <- NormalizeData(pbmc_singlets)
pbmc_singlets <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc_singlets)
pbmc_singlets <- ScaleData(pbmc_singlets)
pbmc_singlets <- RunPCA(pbmc_singlets)
pbmc_singlets <- RunUMAP(pbmc_singlets, dims = 1:30)
pbmc_singlets <- FindNeighbors(pbmc_singlets, dims = 1:30)
pbmc_singlets <- FindClusters(pbmc_singlets, resolution = 0.5)

DimPlot(pbmc_singlets, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("PBMC Data After Doublet Removal")

saveRDS(pbmc_singlets, file = "pbmc_singlets_cleaned.rds")

write.csv(pbmc@meta.data, file = "doublet_detection_results.csv")

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript

# =============================================================================
# PBMC scRNA-seq Analysis Pipeline using Seurat
# =============================================================================
# Description: Complete workflow from raw counts to cell type annotation
# Author: BioAssistant (ROLV)
# Date: 2024
# =============================================================================

# Load required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(future)
})

# Set up parallel processing
plan("multisession", workers = 4)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2)  # 8GB

# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================

# Input/Output paths
INPUT_DIR <- "data/raw_counts"
OUTPUT_DIR <- "results/seurat_analysis"
QC_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "qc_plots")
ANALYSIS_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "analysis")
MARKERS_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "markers")

# Create output directories
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(QC_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(ANALYSIS_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(MARKERS_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# QC thresholds
MIN_FEATURES <- 200
MAX_FEATURES <- 2500
MAX_MT_PERCENT <- 5

# Analysis parameters
N_PCS <- 30
RESOLUTION <- 0.5

# =============================================================================
# LOGGING FUNCTION
# =============================================================================

log_message <- function(message) {
  timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  cat(sprintf("[%s] %s\n", timestamp, message))
}

# =============================================================================
# 1. DATA LOADING
# =============================================================================

log_message("Starting PBMC scRNA-seq analysis pipeline")
log_message("Loading raw count data...")

# Load data (adjust based on your input format)
# Option 1: 10X format
if (dir.exists(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))) {
  pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = file.path(INPUT_DIR, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))
  pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, 
                             project = "PBMC", 
                             min.cells = 3, 
                             min.features = MIN_FEATURES)
}

# Option 2: Matrix file
# pbmc.data <- read.table(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "counts_matrix.txt"), 
#                         header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
# pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, 
#                           project = "PBMC", 
#                           min.cells = 3, 
#                           min.features = MIN_FEATURES)

log_message(sprintf("Loaded %d cells and %d genes", 
                   ncol(pbmc), nrow(pbmc)))

# =============================================================================
# 2. QUALITY CONTROL
# =============================================================================

log_message("Performing quality control...")

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Calculate ribosomal percentage
pbmc[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^RP[SL]")

# QC metrics before filtering
qc_before <- data.frame(
  nCount_RNA = pbmc$nCount_RNA,
  nFeature_RNA = pbmc$nFeature_RNA,
  percent.mt = pbmc$percent.mt,
  percent.ribo = pbmc$percent.ribo
)

# Violin plots - before filtering
p1 <- VlnPlot(pbmc, 
              features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.ribo"),
              ncol = 4, pt.size = 0.1) +
  plot_annotation(title = "QC Metrics Before Filtering")

ggsave(file.path(QC_DIR, "qc_violin_before.png"), 
       plot = p1, width = 16, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Feature scatter plots
p2 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = MAX_MT_PERCENT, linetype = "dashed", color = "red")

p3 <- FeatureScatter(pbmc, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(MIN_FEATURES, MAX_FEATURES), 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red")

ggsave(file.path(QC_DIR, "qc_scatter.png"), 
       plot = p2 + p3, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Apply QC filters
log_message(sprintf("Applying QC filters: nFeature %d-%d, MT < %d%%", 
                   MIN_FEATURES, MAX_FEATURES, MAX_MT_PERCENT))

pbmc <- subset(pbmc, 
               subset = nFeature_RNA > MIN_FEATURES & 
                       nFeature_RNA < MAX_FEATURES & 
                       percent.mt < MAX_MT_PERCENT)

log_message(sprintf("After filtering: %d cells retained", ncol(pbmc)))

# QC metrics after filtering
p4 <- VlnPlot(pbmc, 
              features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.ribo"),
              ncol = 4, pt.size = 0.1) +
  plot_annotation(title = "QC Metrics After Filtering")

ggsave(file.path(QC_DIR, "qc_violin_after.png"), 
       plot = p4, width = 16, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# Save QC summary
qc_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Total cells (before)", "Total cells (after)", 
             "Cells removed", "Percent retained"),
  Value = c(nrow(qc_before), ncol(pbmc), 
            nrow(qc_before) - ncol(pbmc),
            round(ncol(pbmc)/nrow(qc_before)*100, 2))
)

write.csv(qc_summary, file.path(QC_DIR, "qc_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# 3. NORMALIZATION
# =============================================================================

log_message("Normalizing data...")

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, 
                      normalization.method = "LogNormalize", 
                      scale.factor = 10000)

# =============================================================================
# 4. FEATURE SELECTION
# =============================================================================

log_message("Identifying highly variable features...")

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, 
                             selection.method = "vst", 
                             nfeatures = 2000)

# Plot variable features
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)

p5 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
p6 <- LabelPoints(plot = p5, points = top10, repel = TRUE)

ggsave(file.path(ANALYSIS_DIR, "variable_features.png"), 
       plot = p6, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Save variable features
write.csv(data.frame(Gene = VariableFeatures(pbmc)),
          file.path(ANALYSIS_DIR, "variable_features.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# =============================================================================
# 5. SCALING AND PCA
# =============================================================================

log_message("Scaling data and running PCA...")

# Scale data
all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc), npcs = N_PCS)

# Visualize PCA
p7 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca") + 
  ggtitle("PCA Plot")

p8 <- DimHeatmap(pbmc, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE, ncol = 3)

ggsave(file.path(ANALYSIS_DIR, "pca_plot.png"),

pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc), npcs = N_PCS)

# Visualize PCA
p7 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca") + 
  ggtitle("PCA Plot")

p8 <- DimHeatmap(pbmc, dims = 1:15, cells = 500, balanced = TRUE, ncol = 3)

ggsave(file.path(ANALYSIS_DIR, "pca_plot.png"), 
       plot = p7, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(ANALYSIS_DIR, "pca_heatmap.png"), 
       plot = p8, width = 12, height = 16, dpi = 300)

# Elbow plot for PC selection
p9 <- ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = N_PCS) +
  ggtitle("Elbow Plot - PC Selection")

ggsave(file.path(ANALYSIS_DIR, "elbow_plot.png"), 
       plot = p9, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# =============================================================================
# 6. CLUSTERING
# =============================================================================

log_message("Performing clustering...")

# Determine optimal number of PCs (using elbow method)
# You can adjust this based on the elbow plot
n_pcs_use <- 20

pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:n_pcs_use)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = RESOLUTION)

log_message(sprintf("Identified %d clusters", 
                   length(unique(Idents(pbmc)))))

# =============================================================================
# 7. UMAP DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION
# =============================================================================

log_message("Running UMAP...")

pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:n_pcs_use)

# UMAP visualization
p10 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 6) +
  ggtitle("UMAP - Cell Clusters")

ggsave(file.path(ANALYSIS_DIR, "umap_clusters.png"), 
       plot = p10, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# UMAP colored by QC metrics
p11 <- FeaturePlot(pbmc, 
                   features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", 
                               "percent.mt", "percent.ribo"),
                   ncol = 2)

ggsave(file.path(ANALYSIS_DIR, "umap_qc_metrics.png"), 
       plot = p11, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# =============================================================================
# 8. FIND CLUSTER MARKERS
# =============================================================================

log_message("Finding cluster markers...")

# Find markers for all clusters
pbmc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, 
                               only.pos = TRUE, 
                               min.pct = 0.25, 
                               logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Get top markers per cluster
top_markers <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

# Save all markers
write.csv(pbmc.markers, 
          file.path(MARKERS_DIR, "all_cluster_markers.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(top_markers, 
          file.path(MARKERS_DIR, "top10_markers_per_cluster.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Heatmap of top markers
top5 <- pbmc.markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC)

p12 <- DoHeatmap(pbmc, features = top5$gene) + 
  NoLegend() +
  ggtitle("Top 5 Markers per Cluster")

ggsave(file.path(MARKERS_DIR, "marker_heatmap.png"), 
       plot = p12, width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 300)

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, project = "PBMC")

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Differential expression between cluster 0 and 3
markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = 0, ident.2 = 3, logfc.threshold = 0)

# Volcano plot
markers <- markers %>% 
  mutate(gene = rownames(markers),
         log2FC = avg_log2FC,
         p_adj = p_val_adj,
         neg_log10_padj = -log10(p_adj),
         significant = abs(log2FC) > 1 & p_adj < 0.05)

  geom_point(aes(color = significant), alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey" = "grey", "TRUE" = "red")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Volcano Plot: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3",
       x = "Log2 Fold Change",
       y = "-log10 Adjusted P-value",
       color = "Significant") +
  theme_minimal()

# 1. Load PBMC data (assuming 10X Genomics format)
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "path/to/10x/data")
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# 2. Add metadata: percent mitochondrial genes
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# 3. QC filtering
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# 4. Normalization
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# 5. Identify highly variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# 6. Scaling
all.genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all.genes)

# 7. PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# 8. Determine dimensionality (ElbowPlot)
ElbowPlot(pbmc)

# 9. UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# 10. Clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# 11. Visualize clusters
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + NoLegend()

# 12. Identify cluster markers
pbmc.markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# 13. Save markers to CSV
write.csv(pbmc.markers, file = "PBMC_cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 14. Annotate clusters using known markers
cluster.ids <- c("CD4 T", "CD8 T", "NK", "B", "Monocytes", "Dendritic", "Megakaryocytes")
names(cluster.ids) <- levels(pbmc)
pbmc <- RenameIdents(pbmc, cluster.ids)

# 15. Visualize annotated clusters
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.5) + NoLegend()

# 16. Save Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "PBMC_seurat_object.rds")

  pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
  pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)
}

cluster2 <- "1"

de_results <- FindMarkers(pbmc_subset, ident.1 = cluster1, ident.2 = cluster2, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
